question: Choose the word that means the same as "Puzzle".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Paradox**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Paradox"** refers to a statement or situation that seems contradictory or impossible at first but may reveal an underlying truth upon closer examination. (विरोधाभास)
 
 
• **Example:** "This statement is false" is a classic example of a paradox.
 
 
• **"Puzzle"** is something difficult to understand or solve, often presenting a challenging or confusing problem. (पहेली)
 
 
• **Example:** The detective worked tirelessly to solve the puzzle of the missing artifact.
